name: Design
description: An open canvas for free arrangement - text, images, shapes and live renders from your other Lolly tools, all held to your brand.

featured.blurb: Free-form layouts on an open canvas

boxes.text: “The best way to predict the future is to design it.”

inputs.label: Document unit
inputs.help: The unit used for the document size and export dimensions. Geometry stays in CSS pixels internally so existing documents remain exact.

inputs.label: Document DPI
inputs.help: Raster resolution used when this document is exported in a physical unit.

inputs.label: Authoring guides
inputs.help: Editor-only ruler guides stored with the document. They help alignment and never appear in exports.

inputs.label: Custom CSS
inputs.help: Advanced (plan 112): CSS applied to the whole document - editor, export, and presentation. Scoped to the canvas, so @keyframes work at the top level. `@import` and `</style` are stripped for safety. Target `.lolly-box`, a frame with `[data-frame-id="…"]`, or a present-mode state such as `.pr-active`.

inputs.label: Slide transition
inputs.help: How slides change in presentation mode (plan 112 M5). Morph animates matching boxes - same text, the same image, or a shared match key - from one slide to the next. Fly between artboards moves the camera across the canvas, zooming out and back in, so the audience sees where each slide sits. A single artboard can override this with its own Transition to next.

inputs.label: Auto-advance slides
inputs.help: When presenting, move to the next slide after its length runs out. Off by default: slides advance on click.

inputs.label: Narration voice
inputs.help: Which voice reads your speaker notes when you choose Narrate (plan 180). Empty uses the built-in default. A blend such as af_heart+bf_lily:0.3 mixes two voices. The voices are English only, so notes in another language are still read with an English accent.

inputs.label: Narration speed
inputs.help: How fast the narration voice reads, where 1 is its natural pace.

inputs.label: Narration lead-in (ms)
inputs.help: Silence before the first word of each slide, so the narration does not start while the slide is still arriving. Raised automatically when a slide's own enter motion is longer.

inputs.label: Narration tail (ms)
inputs.help: Silence after the last word of each slide, before it leaves. What makes the slide change read as deliberate rather than a cut-off.

inputs.label: Show captions when presenting
inputs.help: Keep generated caption boxes on screen in presentation mode. Off by default: captions are for a video someone watches on their own, and at a podium the same words are being spoken out loud. Exports and video renders always keep them.

fields.label: Image, animation or video
fields.help: A photo, logo, SVG, GIF, Lottie animation, or a short video (MP4/WebM). Animations and video play live on the canvas; still exports (PNG/SVG/PDF) capture the current frame.

fields.label: Text
fields.help: Rich text: **bold**, *italic* / _italic_, and lines starting with - or • become bullets.

fields.label: Weight
fields.help: How heavy the heaviest cut is depends on the font - the mono stack is capped at Extrabold (800).

fields.label: Kerning
fields.help: Uniform letter spacing (tracking) in px. Baked into the vector export.

fields.label: Ligatures
fields.help: Standard ligatures (fi, fl, …). Applies on screen and in the outlined SVG/PDF/EMF export.

fields.label: Stylistic alternates
fields.help: OpenType stylistic alternates (salt), where the font provides them.

fields.label: Shadow
fields.help: What the drop shadow applies to: the box outline, the text, the visible content (image alpha), or Depth - a soft shadow derived from the box's own depth, so lifting a box off the surface casts further. Raster and SVG export are faithful. In PDF, box and text shadows stay vector; content and Depth follow the shape of the artwork, so those boxes export as an embedded image.

fields.label: Image position
fields.help: Which edge or corner the image is anchored to - where a contained image sits inside the box, or which part of a cover-cropped image stays in frame. Honoured on screen and in PNG/SVG/PDF export.

fields.label: Shrink text to fit
fields.help: Automatically shrink the text so it fits inside the box (shrink-only - never larger than the set size). Off by default, so the box grows to the text instead.

A vector path box's authored path (nodes, handles and spline kind), encoded by host.geom.encodeAuthored. Written by the pen tool and read by the hook; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar because it is machine-written, never typed. Coordinates are fractions of the box frame, so move/resize/rotate act on it through x/y/w/h/rot.

fields.label: Start (s)
fields.help: Seconds into the timeline this box appears - empty means it's always visible (scenery).

fields.label: Duration (s)
fields.help: How many seconds this box stays visible for - empty means it stays to the end.

fields.label: Trim in (s)
fields.help: Seconds to trim off the start of this box's own media (video/audio/lottie) before it plays.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Playback speed multiplier for this box's media.

fields.label: Stroke style
fields.help: Solid, dashed or dotted. The dash pattern is derived from the stroke width, so it keeps its proportions when the width changes.

fields.label: Gradient
fields.description: Gradient fill as a Lolly gradient spec - kind_angle_colour-pos_colour-pos, e.g. lin_90_30ba78-0_efefef-100 (lin/rad/con; add .srgb or .oklch.longer to the kind to change how the colours are interpolated). Painted over the flat Fill, so a translucent stop composites onto it. Empty means no gradient.

fields.label: Blur
fields.help: Gaussian blur of the whole box (layer blur), px. 0 = off. Raster-faithful; carried as a real SVG filter in SVG export, and as an embedded image in PDF.

fields.label: Dash length
fields.help: Length of each dash in px. 0 uses a pattern based on the stroke width.

fields.label: Gap length
fields.help: Space between dashes in px. 0 uses a pattern based on the stroke width.

fields.label: Backdrop blur
fields.help: Frosted glass. Blurs whatever sits behind the box, px. 0 = off.

fields.label: In easing
fields.help: The timing curve the animate-in preset's GEOMETRY follows: a preset name (linear, ease-out, ease-in, ease-in-out, overshoot, anticipate, smooth, snappy) or a CSS cubic-bezier(a,b,c,d). Empty leaves the preset on its own built-in curve, which is what every composition authored before this control existed still renders with. Opacity is not governed by it.

fields.label: Out easing
fields.help: The same curve control for the animate-out preset. Same wire format, same geometry-only reach.

fields.label: Path start
fields.help: An arrowhead at the path's FIRST point, pointing back out along the curve's own tangent. A spline, a line and a connector are one shape here, so they all take the same six heads.

fields.label: Path end
fields.help: An arrowhead at the path's LAST point, pointing out along the curve's own tangent. The line tool sets this to Arrow; every other path starts with None.

fields.label: Dash array
fields.help: The dash pattern as plain numbers, space separated, in the same units as the stroke width: 6 4 is a 6 long dash with a 4 long gap. Set, it wins over Stroke style. Empty keeps the width proportional pattern that Stroke style derives.

fields.label: Fit dashes to corners
fields.help: Stretch the dash pattern a little so a whole number of dashes fits between each corner and each end of the path, instead of a half dash landing on a corner. Applies to an authored Dash array.

fields.label: Start attached to
fields.help: The id of the box this path's first point is attached to, empty for a free point. Written by the editor, never typed: a path with an attached end is a connector, routed to that box's border and re-routed when it moves.

fields.label: End attached to
fields.help: The id of the box this path's last point is attached to, empty for a free point. Written by the editor, never typed.

fields.label: Route
fields.help: How a path with an attached end is routed between the boxes. Auto reads it off the spline type: straight lines route straight, a polyline of three or more points routes as an elbow, spiro bows, and every other spline type routes as a smooth S. Pick one here for the bends auto cannot name. Ignored while both ends are free.

fields.label: Depth
fields.help: How far this box sits above the surface, in px - 0 is on the surface, negative sinks it below. Depth drives the camera's parallax and the Depth shadow. Machine-managed by the depth slider, so showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Keyframes
fields.help: This box's keyframe track: poses over its own local time, written compactly (t0_z0_b4*t1500_eo_z140). Machine-written by the timeline panel, never typed; anything outside the token grammar is dropped when the box renders.

fields.label: Linked to
fields.help: The id of the box this one is A/V-linked to - written on BOTH sides when a clip's audio is detached onto its own lane, so re-attaching works from either side. Machine-written by the timeline panel, never typed; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Play sound when presenting
fields.help: When on, this box's audio plays (unmuted) while its slide is active in presentation mode (plan 112). Off by default so a deck never blares. Set from the right-click menu on a video box; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Build step
fields.help: Presentation build order (plan 112): a box with a build number stays hidden until that step is advanced to; empty means always visible. Boxes sharing a number reveal together. Set from the right-click menu; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Frame state
fields.help: Presentation state tokens (plan 112 M4): space-separated names (a–z, 0–9, -) stamped as data-frame-state on this frame's page and, while it is the active slide, as classes on the presenter root. Target with Custom CSS, e.g. [data-frame-state~="dark"] .lolly-box { … }. Set from the right-click menu on a frame; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Morph match key
fields.help: Presentation MORPH (plan 112 M5): give two boxes on adjacent slides the same key and, with the Morph transition, one animates into the other. Optional - boxes with identical text or the same image already morph implicitly; a key is the explicit override that survives an edit. Set from the right-click menu; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Speaker notes
fields.help: Presentation SPEAKER NOTES (plan 112 M5): free text stamped as data-frame-notes on a frame's page and shown only in the speaker view while that slide is active - never rendered on the slide the audience sees. Set from the right-click menu on a frame; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar.

fields.label: Flip horizontal
fields.help: Mirror this box horizontally. Folded into the box transform as a negative scale about its centre, so it mirrors the artwork on the canvas AND in every export (PNG/SVG/PDF), and composes with rotation. Set from the right-click menu or Shift+H; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after the presentation deck fields - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Flip vertical
fields.help: Mirror this box vertically. Folded into the box transform as a negative scale about its centre, so it mirrors the artwork on the canvas AND in every export (PNG/SVG/PDF), and composes with rotation. Set from the right-click menu or Shift+V; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after flipH - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: CSS class
fields.help: Your own class names for this box (space-separated, a-z 0-9 - _), so Custom CSS can say .callout { … } instead of addressing an id. Added to the box's class list on the canvas, in every export and in presentation - one document, one truth. Names in the app's own namespaces (lolly- pr- seq- fc-) are dropped. Set from the right-click menu; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after flipV - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Volume
fields.help: This clip's audio level: 1 plays it as recorded, 0 is silent, and up to 2 boosts it to twice as loud. Set from the timeline inspector's Volume row; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after cls - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Clip name
fields.help: Your own name for this clip on the timeline - shown on its bar in place of the derived text/media label. Set by double-clicking the bar or from its right-click menu; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after gain - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Skip on playback
fields.help: Strikethrough / ignore: this clip keeps its media and its place on the timeline but is skipped on playback and dropped from every export - the reversible dual of a hard delete (plans/174-transcript-driven-editing.md). Set from the transcript panel or the clip's right-click menu; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after name - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Animate text by
fields.help: Split the box's text so its Animate in/out runs per unit instead of as one block (plans/175 WP-A). Letter tier segments by grapheme cluster - emoji, combining marks and precomposed ligatures stay whole - and silently degrades to Word for joining scripts (Arabic and friends), where per-letter spans would break contextual shaping. Edited from the timeline inspector; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after ignored - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Text stagger (ms)
fields.help: Start-to-start gap between text units, ms. With Animate in set to Cut, split + stagger IS the typewriter: each unit simply appears at its offset. APPENDED after split.

fields.label: Text order
fields.help: The order units animate in. Random is dealt from a seed hashed off the box id, so preview, export and a shared URL all shuffle identically. APPENDED after stagger.

fields.label: While on screen
fields.help: A small looping motion while the box is on screen (plans/175 WP-B) - the Loop/Emphasis bucket beside Animate in/out. A deterministic sinusoid of the box's own clock, so preview, export and shared URLs render identically. Edited from the timeline inspector; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after splitOrder - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Hold speed (cycles/sec)
fields.help: How many cycles per second the hold motion runs at. APPENDED after hold.

fields.label: Tilt X
fields.help: Pitch, in degrees - how far the box leans away from the surface about its own horizontal axis. The pivot is the box centre and the vanishing point is the box's own, so a tilt reads the same on a still board as it does under a camera. Empty is flat; empty (not 0) so the compact-blocks URL trims it and an untilted board's link is unchanged. APPENDED after holdRate.

fields.label: Tilt Y
fields.help: Yaw, in degrees - how far the box turns about its own vertical axis. Applied before the pitch (the pan/tilt-head order the camera uses, so the two never disagree), pivoting on the box centre. Empty is flat. APPENDED after rx.

fields.label: Pan
fields.help: This clip's stereo position when the sequence is mixed: -1 is hard left, 0 keeps it centred, 1 is hard right (equal-power). Set from the timeline inspector's Pan row; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. Empty is centred. APPENDED after ry - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Under other audio
fields.help: The level this audio box drops to while any other clip's audio plays: empty leaves it alone, 0.2 lowers it under speech, 0 silences it. Set from the timeline inspector's Under-other-audio row; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after pan - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Pitch
fields.help: Transpose this clip's audio in semitones (-12 to 12, formants preserved): 12 is up an octave. Works at any speed. Set from the timeline inspector's Pitch row; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. Empty is as recorded. APPENDED after duck - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Pitch follows speed
fields.help: Empty keeps a speed-changed clip at its recorded pitch - the editor default. True plays it tape-style: pitch rises with speed and falls with slow motion. Set from the timeline inspector's Preserve-pitch toggle; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after pitch.

fields.label: Audio effect
fields.help: This clip's audio effect chain in the engine's fx grammar (e.g. hp(90).eq(230-280-270).gate(55)) - the timeline inspector's Effect presets write the expanded chain here so a later preset re-tune never changes what a shared link sounds like. Unknown entries are skipped, never an error. Empty is no effect. Set from the timeline inspector; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after varispeed - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Stacks under
fields.help: For a FRAME: the id of the column-head frame this one stacks vertically under in present mode (the 4-arrow sub-slide nav). Empty is a column head. With none authored anywhere, frames sharing an x-column stack automatically - writing this field anywhere turns that inference off. Set from the frame's context menu; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after fx - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Hidden
fields.help: Hidden layers are not drawn and not exported.

fields.label: Locked
fields.help: Locked layers cannot be selected or moved on the canvas.

fields.label: Transition to next
fields.help: For a FRAME: how THIS slide changes into the next one, overriding the document's own Slide transition. Empty follows the deck. 'Custom (set in the timeline)' means the frame's own Enter/Exit rows in the timeline inspector are the truth and nothing derives them. Set from the artboard inspector; showFor:[] keeps it out of the sidebar. APPENDED after locked - the compact-blocks URL wire format is append-only.

fields.label: Plain text
fields.help: Print every character as entered, including Markdown markers. Useful for linked briefs and imported copy. Appended to preserve existing compact URLs.

default.text: Double-click any text to edit it. Every colour and typeface here comes from your brand.
